DP World Limited - Coupon Payment and Final Principal Payment

Friday, 18th September 2026, Dubai, UAE:  DP World Limited is pleased to confirm the periodic coupon payment and final principal payment for DP World Limited EUR 750 million 2.375% Notes due 2026 (XS1883878966 / XS1883966076).
In total, EUR 767,812,500.00 will be distributed to Note Holders on 25 September 2026.
DP World Limited                                                                   DP World Limited

DP World is reshaping the future of global trade to improve lives everywhere. Operating across six continents with a team of over 125,000 employees, we combine global infrastructure and local expertise to deliver seamless supply chain solutions. From Ports and Terminals to Marine Services, Logistics and Technology, we leverage innovation to create better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer's door.
